description: Target availability for the capability coverage ledger: profiles lists targets with provisioned execution; absent lists required targets with no execution and the excuse the ledger attaches to their cells. A BLOCKED_* entry keeps cells OPEN as outstanding work; a NOT_APPLICABLE entry excludes them and must cite source_refs. A required target in neither list fails materialization. evidence_profiles maps each profile to the library-row evidence profiles accepted as qualification for that target, and runtime_profiles maps each profile to the row profiles accepted for the target_runtime layer; every layer of a qualifying row must name an accepted profile from its gate.
